prep.summary:
Performance and fixture cleanup are complete. Shared factories now cover organizations, customers, payment methods, and invoices, with invoice organizations persisted. Test isolation was strengthened by truncating idempotency records and clearing the external payment stub response map. Invoice tests are fast, and targeted invoice, payment, customer, subscription, and report suites pass.

The intermittent duplicate invoice-sync conflict was fixed by completing idempotency only when both the request key and invoice ID match, avoiding overwrite by a mismatched request. A concurrent duplicate-sync regression test was added for `test-inv-1042`. Integration tests (31 latest), unit tests (14), and full-suite runs passed; an earlier full run reported 318 passed and 4 skipped. A 200-request stress test with 20 concurrent clients yielded 8 submissions, 192 valid replays, no 500s, and exactly one completed record with the original response. Ruff lint and formatting pass.

Remaining work:
- Continue monitoring or further hardening of the rare idempotency race, historically a `409` with a stuck `processing` record.
- Document ledger posting through invariants; consider replay tooling later.
- Implement tax resolution via billing address with account-default fallback.
- Add operator-triggered refunds.
- Correct `apply_credit` ordering so refunds are not deducted incorrectly.
- Evaluate deprecating synchronous tax preview APIs for compatibility.
- Improve webhook delayed-delivery observability.
- Revisit legacy CSV removal and queue-based cron architecture only when justified.
